import json
import trace
from pathlib import Path
import pytest

TARGET = Path('telegram/ext/_applicationbuilder.py').resolve()

tracer = trace.Trace(count=True, trace=False)

results = tracer.results()

    lineno

    if count > 0 and Path(filename).resolve() == TARGET and 291 <= lineno <= 346
})
print('EXIT_CODE', exit_code)
print('COVERED', covered)
